SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T6.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID shareId, T5.FINPROD_ID shareFinprodId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T5.FINPROD_NAME shareName, T6.ACT_NUM*100 holdetrPriceTotal, IFNULL(T7.AMOUNT*100,0) conetrPriceTotal, T6.PREC prec, T6.PREB preb, T4.CON_PRICE conPrice, T6.SHARE_PRICE sharePrice, T6.EXP_CON_VALUE expConValue, T6.EXP_CON_NUM expConNum, T1.INV_AIM invAim, T4.CON_VDATE conVdate, T4.CON_SHARE_ID conShareId, T1.CCY ccy, T1.PS ps, T1.ENTRUST_AMT * 100 stocketrPriceTotal, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T1.chl_id chlId, T6.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_CONVERTIBLE T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T4.CON_FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T6 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T6.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION where HODING_TYPE = #{hodingType} AND CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d')) T7 ON T7.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

select PRIN_AMT*-1 from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 inner join WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2. TRADE_ID inner join WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 on T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID
T2.PA_BUSS_TYPE = #{repoType} AND T1.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND T1.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{manageId} AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

select PRIN_AMT * -1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 inner join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 on T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID
T2.PA_BUSS_TYPE = #{repoType} AND T1.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND T1.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{manageId} AND T3.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
